story.title: Independent Media and Online Critics Face Growing Censorship Risk as India's Content Takedown Infrastructure Expands
story.summary: An investigative report by The Hindu finds that an expanding infrastructure of content takedown mechanisms — enabled by existing laws and IT rules — is being used by Central and State governments to suppress social media content, with independent media outlets and online critics increasingly caught in its crosshairs. The report documents how, in an environment of heightened concern about misinformation and deepfakes, legitimate opposing voices are also being targeted under the same regulatory tools. The analysis highlights how the lack of transparency in takedown orders makes it nearly impossible for affected parties to challenge removals. The piece adds fresh evidence to ongoing expert concerns about the erosion of digital free speech in India.
